title.zh: 卷342 列傳一百二十九 保寧 松筠子：熙昌 富俊 窦心傳 博启图
title.en: Volume 342 Biographies 129: Bao Ning, Song Yun son: Xi Chang, Fu Jun, Dou Xinchuan, Bo Qi Tu
title.raw: 卷342 列傳一百二十九 保寧 松筠子：熙昌 富俊 窦心傳 博启图

sentences.zh: 保寧，圖伯特氏，蒙古正白旗人，靖逆將軍納穆札勒子。

translations.literal: Bao Ning, of the Tubote clan, a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, was the son of Pacification General Namuzhale.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning, of the Tubote clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain White Banner and the son of Pacification General Namuzhale.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，納穆札勒殉節回疆，錫封三等公。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, Namuzhale died loyally in the Muslim borderlands and was posthumously enfeoffed as a third-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianlong era, Namuzhale gave his life in the Muslim borderlands and was posthumously granted the rank of third-class duke.

sentences.zh: 保寧由親軍襲爵，授乾清門侍衛。

translations.literal: Bao Ning inherited the title through the Imperial Guard and was appointed a Gate Guard of the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning inherited his father's title through service in the Imperial Guard and was appointed a gate guard of the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，力戰，迭克要隘，​​將軍阿桂薦其才，擢陝西興漢鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He joined the campaign against Jinchuan, fought fiercely, and captured strategic passes in succession; General Agui recommended his talent, and he was promoted to regional commander of Xinghan Garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the Jinchuan campaign he fought hard and took one vital pass after another; General Agui praised his ability, and he was promoted to regional commander of Xinghan Garrison in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 金川平，繪像紫光閣，御製贊，褒其膽勇持重，少年如宿將。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor with an imperial eulogy praising his courage and steadiness, saying that though young he was like a veteran general.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was hung in the Hall of Purple Splendor with an imperial inscription praising his boldness and composure—a young man who fought like a seasoned commander.

sentences.zh: 尋調河南南陽鎮、直隸馬蘭鎮，兼總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He was soon transferred to Nanyang Garrison in Henan and Malan Garrison in Zhili, and also served as superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon moved to command Nanyang Garrison in Henan and Malan Garrison in Zhili, while also serving as superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 擢江南提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provincial commander of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to provincial military commander of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，授成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, he was appointed General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year of the reign, he was appointed general of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 甘肅石峰堡回叛，命選屯練番兵赴鞏昌、安定助剿，平之。

translations.literal: When Muslims at Shifeng Fort in Gansu rebelled, he was ordered to select trained garrison troops and native soldiers to assist in suppressing them at Gongchang and Anding; the rebellion was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Muslims at Shifeng Fort in Gansu rose in revolt, he was ordered to send trained garrison and native troops to Gongchang and Anding to help suppress them, and the rebellion was put down.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，授四川總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, he was appointed Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year he was made governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 保寧謹慎有操守，盡心邊事。

translations.literal: Bao Ning was cautious and principled and devoted himself wholeheartedly to frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning was careful, upright, and wholly devoted to border administration.

sentences.zh: 邊夷上下孟董、九子等寨生齒日繁，請增設營員，以屯練有勞績者拔補；

translations.literal: Among the frontier tribes, the populations of the upper and lower Mengdong and Jiuzi stockades were growing daily; he requested additional garrison officers, to be filled by promoting men from the trained garrisons who had rendered merit;
translations.idiomatic: Frontier communities at stockades such as upper and lower Mengdong and Jiuzi were growing rapidly; he asked for more garrison officers, to be drawn from trained troops who had distinguished themselves;

sentences.zh: 改修打箭爐城，扼要築卡，駐兵捍衛；

translations.literal: he had Dartsedo rebuilt, built barrier posts at strategic points, and stationed troops to defend them;
translations.idiomatic: had Dartsedo repaired, built barrier posts at key points, and stationed troops to guard them;

sentences.zh: 改黃梁、大定、白雞、白鹿等八寨熟苗編入民戶：並協機宜。

translations.literal: and had the acculturated Miao of eight stockades including Huangliang, Dading, Baiji, and Bailu registered as civilian households—all measures well suited to the situation.
translations.idiomatic: and registered the acculturated Miao of eight stockades, including Huangliang, Dading, Baiji, and Bailu, as regular civilian households—all of which he coordinated to good effect.

sentences.zh: 次年，調伊犁將軍，兼內大臣，籌備倉儲。

translations.literal: The following year he was transferred to be General of Ili, concurrently serving as a Grand Minister of the Interior, and made preparations for granaries.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to general of Ili, also serving as a grand minister of the interior, and set about organizing grain reserves.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「伊犁一年支糧十六萬六千餘石，不敷二萬三千石，歷就舊儲五十餘萬石內填補。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "Ili requires more than 166,000 shi of grain annually, with a shortfall of 23,000 shi, which has been made up from old reserves of more than 500,000 shi.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Ili needs more than 166,000 shi of grain each year, with a shortfall of 23,000 shi that has been covered from old stores of over 500,000 shi.

sentences.zh: 現賸三十餘萬石，雖尚可敷十餘年之用，地處極邊，若不補籌餘糧，偶遇歉收，或有需糧之事，慮難接濟。

translations.literal: Only a little over 300,000 shi remain; though this could still supply more than ten years, the region lies at the outermost frontier. If surplus grain is not replenished, should there be a poor harvest or an emergency need for grain, I fear supplies will be hard to sustain."
translations.idiomatic: Only a little over 300,000 shi remain. That might still last more than ten years, but Ili is at the empire's farthest edge. Unless we build up reserves again, a bad harvest or sudden demand for grain could leave us unable to meet the need."

sentences.zh: 請撥兵丁七百名，增開七屯，自來年耕種，歲可收糧一萬九千餘石，永遠備貯。

translations.literal: He requested that 700 soldiers be assigned to open seven new military colonies; from the coming year they would farm, yielding more than 19,000 shi annually for permanent reserve.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for seven hundred troops to open seven new military farms; planting would begin the next year, yielding more than 19,000 shi a year for permanent storage.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏添設惠遠城鳥槍步甲四百名。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to add four hundred musket infantry at Huining City.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to add four hundred musket infantry at Huining City.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，入覲，途次命赴四川暫署總督事。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, while proceeding to the capital for an audience, he was ordered en route to go to Sichuan and temporarily act as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year, on his way to court for an audience, he was ordered en route to Sichuan to serve temporarily as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 次年，回任，加太子少保，授御前大臣。

translations.literal: The following year he returned to his post, was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and appointed a Grand Minister in Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he resumed his post, was made junior guardian of the heir apparent, and appointed a grand minister in attendance.

sentences.zh: 惠遠城創立三十餘年，戶口日繁，於城東展築，擴舊城四分之一。

translations.literal: Huining City had been founded for more than thirty years and its population was growing daily; he extended construction east of the city, enlarging the old city by one quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Huining City was more than thirty years old and its population was swelling; he extended the walls on the east side, adding a quarter to the old city.

sentences.zh: 伊犁無通曉俄羅斯語言者，請於京師俄館選派一人來教習官兵子弟，五年期滿，試最優者充筆帖式。

translations.literal: As no one in Ili understood Russian, he requested that one person be selected from the Russian hostel in the capital to teach officers' and soldiers' sons; after five years the best in examination would be appointed a clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Because no one in Ili knew Russian, he asked that someone be sent from the Russian hostel in Beijing to instruct officers' and soldiers' sons; after five years the top student would be appointed a clerk.

sentences.zh: 俄屬烏梁海潛往哈屯河外汗山地方游牧，帝慮其滋事，命保寧察視，疏言：「烏梁海居住甚安戢，不必驅逐，飭邊卡防範，無庸添兵。

translations.literal: Subjects of Russia among the Uriankhai had secretly gone to pasture beyond the Hatun River at Khan Mountain; the emperor feared trouble and ordered Bao Ning to investigate. He reported: "The Uriankhai are living very peacefully and need not be expelled; order the frontier posts to guard against incidents—there is no need to add troops."
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai under Russian rule had quietly moved to pasture beyond the Hatun River near Khan Mountain. The emperor feared trouble and sent Bao Ning to look into it. He reported that the Uriankhai were living peacefully, need not be driven off, and that frontier posts should simply stay alert—no extra troops were required.

sentences.zh: 」察哈爾兵丁及土爾扈特私竊哈薩克馬匹，緝獲，置之法。

translations.literal: Chahar soldiers and Torghut who had privately stolen Kazakh horses were arrested and punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Chahar soldiers and Torghuts caught stealing Kazakh horses privately were arrested and punished by law.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉保寧無偏袒，得外籓心，予議敘。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Bao Ning for showing no favoritism and winning the hearts of the outer vassals, and ordered consideration of rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Bao Ning for impartiality that won over the frontier peoples, and ordered his merits considered for reward.

sentences.zh: 六十年，召授吏部尚書，兼鑲黃旗漢軍都統，甫數月，復出為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he was summoned and appointed Minister of Personnel, concurrently serving as commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese forces; after only a few months he was again sent out as General of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year he was recalled to be minister of personnel and commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese forces; within a few months he was sent back out as general of Ili.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，協辦大學士，尋拜武英殿大學士，加太子太保，任邊事如故。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he was made Associate Grand Secretary, soon promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence, given the additional title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and continued to handle frontier affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he became associate grand secretary, then grand secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence, with the additional title senior guardian of the heir apparent, and continued frontier duties as before.

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特家奴三吉污主母孀婦伯克木庫殞命，特詔予伯克木庫旌表。

translations.literal: The Torghut bondservant Sanji defiled his mistress's widowed daughter-in-law Berkemuku, who died; a special edict granted Berkemuku a commemorative tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The Torghut bondservant Sanji assaulted his mistress's widowed daughter-in-law Berkemuku, who died; the throne specially ordered Berkemuku honored with a commemorative tablet.

sentences.zh: 保寧疏陳駐防孀婦守節，未舉旌表之典，請照內地一體辦理。

translations.literal: Bao Ning memorialized that widows among the garrison who preserved chastity had not been granted commemorative honors and requested that the inland practice be applied uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning noted that chaste widows among the garrisons had not received commemorative honors and asked that inland practice be followed throughout.

sentences.zh: 於是採訪各城，請旌者凡七十人，後著為令。

translations.literal: He then investigated all the cities; seventy persons were recommended for honors, and this was later made a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He then surveyed every garrison city and recommended seventy women for honors; the practice was later codified as regulation.

sentences.zh: 七年，召還京，授領侍衛內大臣，管理兵部，兼管三庫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was recalled to the capital, appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard, placed in charge of the Ministry of War, and also given charge of the three treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was recalled to Beijing, made chief grand minister of the imperial bodyguard, put in charge of the Ministry of War, and also given oversight of the three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 八年，因孝淑皇后山陵典禮會疏措詞不經，褫銜鐫級留任。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because a joint memorial on the mountain tomb rites for Empress Xiaoshu used improper wording, his titles were stripped and his rank reduced, but he was retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year a joint memorial on Empress Xiaoshu's tomb rites used improper language; his titles were stripped and rank reduced, but he kept his post.

sentences.zh: 保寧兩鎮伊犁，歷十餘年，西陲無事，籓部悅服。

translations.literal: Bao Ning governed Ili twice over more than ten years; the western frontier was untroubled and the vassal tribes were content.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Ning held Ili twice over more than a decade; the western frontier stayed quiet and the frontier peoples were content.

sentences.zh: 既去任，朝廷遇邊疆興革，每諮決焉。

translations.literal: After he left office, whenever the court faced frontier innovations or reforms, it regularly sought his judgment.
translations.idiomatic: After he left office, the court still consulted him on every major frontier reform.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以疾乞休，命在家食公爵全俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he requested retirement on grounds of illness and was ordered to remain at home on the full salary of a duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he asked to retire for illness and was allowed to remain at home on a duke's full stipend.

sentences.zh: 逾兩年，卒，賜金優恤，諡文端，祠祀伊犁。

translations.literal: After more than two years he died; gold was granted for generous condolence, his posthumous title was Wenduan, and he was enshrined at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: More than two years later he died; the court granted gold for generous mourning, gave him the posthumous title Wenduan, and enshrined him at Ili.

sentences.zh: 子慶祥嗣爵，殉回疆之難，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Qingxiang inherited the title and died a martyr in the Muslim borderlands troubles; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qingxiang inherited the title and died in the Muslim borderlands crisis; he has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 次子慶惠，由廕生授侍衛，歷官侍郎，三以罪黜復起。

translations.literal: His second son Qinghui, through hereditary privilege appointed a bodyguard, rose to vice minister, and three times was dismissed for crimes yet restored.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Qinghui entered service by hereditary privilege as a bodyguard, rose to vice minister, and was dismissed three times for misconduct yet restored each time.

sentences.zh: 道光中，官至熱河都統，以疾歸，卒，諡勤僖。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang era he reached the post of Commander at Rehe, returned home on account of illness, died, and received the posthumous title Qinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Under Daoguang he became commander at Rehe, retired ill, died, and was given the posthumous title Qinxi.

sentences.zh: 松筠，字湘浦，瑪拉特氏，蒙古正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Songyun, style name Xiangpu, of the Marat clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun, styled Xiangpu, of the Marat clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 繙譯生員，考授理籓院筆帖式，充軍機章京，能任事，為高宗所知。

translations.literal: As a translation licentiate he passed examination and was appointed a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs, served as a secretarial attendant in the Grand Council, proved capable in office, and came to the notice of Emperor Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: A translation licentiate, he passed examination for a clerkship in the Court of Colonial Affairs, served on the Grand Council secretariat, proved capable, and won Emperor Qianlong's notice.

sentences.zh: 累遷銀庫員外郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to vice director of the Silver Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to vice director of the Silver Treasury.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年，超擢內閣學士，兼副都統。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Qianlong he was exceptionally promoted to Grand Secretary of the Secretariat, concurrently serving as vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48 he was abruptly promoted to grand secretary of the Secretariat and made vice commander as well.

sentences.zh: 五十年，命往庫倫治俄羅斯貿易事。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he was ordered to Khuree to manage Russian trade affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year he was sent to Khuree to handle Russian trade.

sentences.zh: 先是，俄屬布哩雅特人劫掠庫倫商貨，俄官不依例交犯，僅罰償，流之遠地，檄問未聽命，詔停恰克圖貿易。

translations.literal: Earlier, Buryats under Russia had plundered merchants' goods at Khuree; the Russian officials did not hand over the culprits as required but only imposed fines and exiled them to distant places. When questioned by official dispatch they did not obey, and trade at Kyakhta was ordered suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Buryats under Russian rule had robbed Khuree merchants. Russian officials refused to surrender the culprits as required, fined and exiled them instead, and ignored official demands—so trade at Kyakhta was halted.

sentences.zh: 松筠至，尋充辦事大臣。

translations.literal: When Songyun arrived, he soon served as Commissioner in Charge of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun arrived and soon became commissioner in charge of affairs.

sentences.zh: 閉關後，邊禁嚴而不擾，遇俄人皆開誠待之。

translations.literal: After the border was closed, frontier restrictions were strict yet not harassing; whenever he met Russians he treated them with open sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: After the border closed, restrictions were strict but not abusive; he met every Russian with frank goodwill.

sentences.zh: 擢戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯以貿易久停，有悔意，撤舊官，屢請開市，未許。

translations.literal: Russia, because trade had long been suspended, showed repentance, removed the old officials, and repeatedly requested reopening the market, but permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: With trade long suspended, Russia showed regret, replaced its old officials, and repeatedly asked to reopen the market, but was refused.

sentences.zh: 卡倫兵出巡，復為布哩雅特人所殺。

translations.literal: When patrol troops from the frontier post went out on circuit, they were again killed by Buryats.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier patrol troops on circuit were again killed by Buryats.

sentences.zh: 松筠曰：「舊事未了，又生旁支，然亦了事之機也。

translations.literal: Songyun said: "The old affair is not settled, and a new branch has arisen—but this may also be the chance to settle everything."
translations.idiomatic: Songyun said, "The old case is unfinished and a new one has sprung up—but this may be the chance to close both."

sentences.zh: 」檄俄官縛送三人，親訊於界上，斬其二，流其一，請兩案並結。

translations.literal: He dispatched a note ordering Russian officials to send three men bound; he personally interrogated them at the border, executed two, exiled one, and requested that both cases be closed together.
translations.idiomatic: He demanded the Russians deliver three men bound, questioned them personally at the border, executed two and exiled one, and asked to close both cases at once.

sentences.zh: 詔斥專擅，褫職，仍留庫倫效力。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for acting on his own authority, stripped his office, yet kept him at Khuree to serve.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked his unauthorized action, stripped his post, but kept him at Khuree to serve.

sentences.zh: 會西路土爾扈特喇嘛薩邁林者，迷路入哈薩克，歸攜書信，訛言俄人誘致土爾扈特謀亂，下松筠察狀。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the Torghut lama Samailin of the western route, having lost his way into Kazakhstan, returned carrying letters spreading false reports that Russians had induced the Torghut to plot rebellion; Songyun was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the western-route Torghut lama Samailin, lost in Kazakh territory, returned with letters falsely claiming Russia had incited the Torghut to rebel; Songyun was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 疏言俄羅斯實恭順，無可疑。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated that Russia was in fact respectful and submissive, with nothing suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Russia was genuinely submissive and not to be suspected.

sentences.zh: 俄人亦自陳證薩邁林書信出偽造。

translations.literal: The Russians also themselves declared and proved that Samailin's letters were forged.
translations.idiomatic: The Russians themselves proved Samailin's letters were forged.

sentences.zh: 詔置薩邁林於法，許復開市。

translations.literal: An edict placed Samailin under the law and permitted reopening the market.
translations.idiomatic: Samailin was punished by law and trade was allowed to reopen.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，召俄官會議定約，親蒞俄帳宴飲，諭以恩信，大悅服。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he summoned Russian officials to negotiate and fix a treaty; he personally attended the Russian tent for a feast, instructed them in grace and trust, and they were greatly pleased and submissive.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he summoned Russian officials to settle a treaty, dined in their tent himself, spoke of imperial grace and good faith, and won their deep satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 事曆八年然後定。

translations.literal: The matter took eight years before it was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years passed before the matter was finally settled.

sentences.zh: 召還京，授御前侍衛、內務府大臣、軍機大臣。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital and appointed Imperial Bodyguard, Minister of the Imperial Household, and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to Beijing, he was made imperial bodyguard, minister of the imperial household, and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 命護送英吉利貢使回廣東，凡所要索皆嚴拒。

translations.literal: He was ordered to escort the English tribute embassy back to Guangdong; every demand they made was sternly refused.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to escort the British tribute mission back to Guangdong and refused every demand they made.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，署吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he acted as General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he served as acting general of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 尋命往荊州察稅務，道出衛輝，大水環城，率守令開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to Jingzhou to inspect tax affairs; passing Weihui, great floods surrounded the city, and he led the prefect and magistrates to open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent to Jingzhou to inspect taxes; passing Weihui, he found the city ringed by flood and led local officials to open granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉獎，授工部尚書兼都統。

translations.literal: An edict praised and rewarded him; he was appointed Minister of Works, concurrently serving as banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended him and appointed him minister of works with concurrent command of a banner.

sentences.zh: 充駐藏大臣，撫番多惠政。

translations.literal: He served as Resident Minister in Tibet and in pacifying the Tibetans enacted many benevolent policies.
translations.idiomatic: As resident minister in Tibet he governed the frontier peoples with many benevolent measures.

sentences.zh: 和珅用事，松筠不為屈，遂久留邊地。

translations.literal: When Heshen held power, Songyun would not yield to him and therefore remained long on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When Heshen dominated court politics, Songyun refused to bend and was kept on the frontier for years.

sentences.zh: 在藏凡五年。

translations.literal: He was in Tibet altogether five years.
translations.idiomatic: He spent five years in Tibet altogether.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年春，召為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Jiaqing he was summoned as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 4 he was recalled as minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 尋授陝甘總督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, with the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu, with the additional title junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 時教匪張漢潮及藍號、白號諸黨擾陝、甘。

translations.literal: At that time the sect rebel Zhang Hanchao and the Blue Banner, White Banner, and other factions were disturbing Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Sect rebels led by Zhang Hanchao and the Blue and White factions were ravaging Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 松筠至，駐漢中，治糧餉給諸軍。

translations.literal: When Songyun arrived, he stationed himself at Hanzhong and managed provisions to supply the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun arrived, based himself at Hanzhong, and organized grain and pay for the armies.

sentences.zh: 自軍興，給陝西餉銀一千一百萬兩，至是續撥一百五十萬，設局清釐，按旬諮部。

translations.literal: Since the campaign began, 11 million taels of pay had been allotted to Shaanxi; at this time another 1.5 million was allocated, an office was established for clearing accounts, and reports were sent to the ministry every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began Shaanxi had received eleven million taels in pay; he secured another 1.5 million, set up an office to clear accounts, and reported to the ministry every ten days.

sentences.zh: 命陳諸將優劣，密疏言：「明亮知兵而罔實效；

translations.literal: He was ordered to report on the merits and faults of the generals and wrote in a secret memorial: "Mingliang understands warfare but achieves no real results;
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to assess the generals, he wrote secretly: "Mingliang knows war but delivers no real results;

sentences.zh: 恆瑞前戰湖北功最，年近六旬，精力大減；

translations.literal: Heng Rui's achievements in the earlier Hubei campaign were greatest, but he is nearly sixty and his vigor has greatly declined;
translations.idiomatic: Heng Rui did best in the earlier Hubei fighting, but he is nearly sixty and much diminished in vigor;

sentences.zh: 慶成有勇無謀；

translations.literal: Qingcheng has courage but no strategy;
translations.idiomatic: Qingcheng is brave but lacks strategy;

sentences.zh: 永保無謀無勇，不能治兵，並不能治民；

translations.literal: Yongbao has neither strategy nor courage, cannot command troops, and cannot govern the people either;
translations.idiomatic: Yongbao has neither strategy nor courage, cannot command troops, and cannot govern civilians either;

sentences.zh: 惟額勒登保、德楞泰能辦賊。

translations.literal: only Erledengbao and Delengtai can deal with the bandits."
translations.idiomatic: only Erledengbao and Delengtai can handle the rebels."

sentences.zh: 」仁宗深嘉納之。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong greatly approved and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong warmly approved.

sentences.zh: 明亮劾永保、慶成避賊，下松筠逮治。

translations.literal: Mingliang impeached Yongbao and Qingcheng for avoiding the bandits; Songyun was ordered to arrest and try them.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang accused Yongbao and Qingcheng of shirking the enemy; Songyun was ordered to arrest and try them.

sentences.zh: 永保亦與荊州將軍興肇訐明亮誑報軍功，詔並褫職，遣尚書那彥成赴陝會鞫。

translations.literal: Yongbao also joined with Jingzhou General Xingzhao in accusing Mingliang of falsely reporting military merit; an edict stripped all of their offices and sent Minister Nayancheng to Shaanxi to conduct a joint trial.
translations.idiomatic: Yongbao also joined Jingzhou general Xingzhao in accusing Mingliang of falsifying battle reports; all were stripped of office and minister Nayancheng was sent to Shaanxi for a joint trial.

sentences.zh: 會明亮已擊斃張漢潮，松筠請緩其獄，又請留撒拉爾回兵，令慶成率以協剿，帝不允。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Mingliang had already killed Zhang Hanchao in battle; Songyun requested that his case be eased, and also asked to retain Salar Muslim troops for Qingcheng to lead in joint suppression—the emperor did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: By then Mingliang had killed Zhang Hanchao in battle; Songyun asked to lighten his case and to keep Salar Muslim troops under Qingcheng for joint operations—the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 既而那彥成劾忄互瑞棄藍號垂盡之賊，折回陝西，由松筠所誤。

translations.literal: Then Nayancheng impeached Heng Rui for abandoning the nearly exhausted Blue Banner bandits and turning back to Shaanxi—an error caused by Songyun.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng then accused Heng Rui of leaving nearly defeated Blue Banner rebels and returning to Shaanxi—blaming Songyun for the mistake.

sentences.zh: 詔褫松筠宮銜、侍衛，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Songyun of his court rank and bodyguard status, yet retained him as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun lost his court rank and bodyguard title but kept the governorship.

sentences.zh: 川匪犯南鄭，復分犯西鄉、沔縣、略陽。

translations.literal: Sichuan bandits attacked Nanzheng and again divided forces to attack Xixiang, Mian County, and Lueyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan rebels struck Nanzheng and sent columns against Xixiang, Mian County, and Lueyang.

sentences.zh: 松筠素謂匪多脅從，可諭降，欲單騎赴之。

translations.literal: Songyun had long held that most bandits were coerced followers who could be persuaded to surrender, and wished to go alone on horseback to them.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun had long believed most rebels were coerced and could be talked into surrendering, and wanted to ride out to them alone.

sentences.zh: 副將韓嘉業固諫曰：「諭之不從而喪總督，大損國威，為天下笑。

translations.literal: Vice General Han Jiaye firmly remonstrated: "If persuasion fails and the governor-general is lost, national prestige will suffer greatly and the empire will be laughed at by all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Vice general Han Jiaye urged him firmly: "If they refuse your appeal and the governor-general is killed, the empire's prestige will suffer and the world will laugh.

sentences.zh: 請先往。

translations.literal: Please let me go first."
translations.idiomatic: Let me go first."

sentences.zh: 」嘉業果被害。

translations.literal: Jiaye was indeed killed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaye was indeed killed.

sentences.zh: 賊竄徽縣、兩當。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Huixian and Liangdang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled into Huixian and Liangdang.

sentences.zh: 五年春，額勒登保、那彥成會剿，乃分路遁。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Erledengbao and Nayancheng conducted a joint campaign, and the bandits split into separate routes and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year Erledengbao and Nayancheng joined forces against them, and the rebels split up and fled.

sentences.zh: 於是命長麟代為陝甘總督，授松筠伊犁將軍，未之任，暫署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Thereupon Changlin was ordered to replace him as Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu; Songyun was appointed General of Ili but did not take up the post and temporarily acted as Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Changlin replaced him as governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu; Songyun was appointed general of Ili but never took up the post and temporarily governed Huguang instead.

sentences.zh: 自請入覲面陳軍事，先在陝上疏言：「賊不患不平，而患在將平之時。

translations.literal: He requested an audience to report on military affairs in person; first in Shaanxi he memorialized: "The bandits are not to be feared when unrest remains, but when suppression is nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to come to court in person on military affairs and first memorialized from Shaanxi: "Rebels are not hardest to defeat while unrest continues, but when suppression is nearly finished.

sentences.zh: 既平之後，請弛私鹽、私鑄之禁，俾餘匪散勇有所謀生。

translations.literal: After pacification, I request that prohibitions on private salt and private coining be relaxed, so that remaining bandits and discharged braves may have means to earn a living."
translations.idiomatic: After pacification, relax bans on private salt and coining so leftover rebels and discharged soldiers can make a living."

sentences.zh: 」帝以其言迂闊，置之。

translations.literal: The emperor considered his words impractical and broad and set them aside.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thought this impractical and ignored it.

sentences.zh: 至京，復以為請，忤旨，降副都統銜，充伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: On reaching the capital he again made the same request, offended the imperial will, was reduced to vice commander's rank, and appointed Brigade Commander at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In Beijing he pressed the same point again, offended the throne, was reduced to vice commander, and sent as brigade commander at Ili.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to General of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to general of Ili.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中屢詔伊犁屯田，皆以灌溉乏水未大興，松筠力任其事，預計安插官兵。

translations.literal: During Qianlong edicts had repeatedly ordered military colonies at Ili, but all failed to flourish greatly for lack of irrigation water; Songyun took the task on vigorously and planned in advance for settling officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong repeated orders had called for military farming at Ili, but poor irrigation had kept it small; Songyun threw himself into the work and planned settlements for officers and troops.

sentences.zh: 惠遠城需八萬畝，惠寧城需四萬畝，乃於伊犁河北引水開渠，逶迤數十里，又於城西北導水泉。

translations.literal: Huining City required 80,000 mu and Huining New City 40,000 mu; he therefore diverted water north of the Ili River to open canals winding for several tens of li, and also channeled springs northwest of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Huining needed eighty thousand mu and Huining New City forty thousand; he drew water from north of the Ili River into canals winding for miles and channeled springs northwest of the cities.

sentences.zh: 凡兩城有水之地皆開渠，授田為世業，給穀種、田器、馬牛。

translations.literal: Wherever both cities had water, canals were opened; land was granted as hereditary property, and grain seed, farm tools, horses, and cattle were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Every watered tract in both cities was canalized; fields were granted as hereditary holdings, with seed grain, tools, horses, and cattle provided.

sentences.zh: 然旗人多驕逸，或殺食所給牛，鬻田器棄不耕，反覆曉諭始聽命。

translations.literal: Yet bannermen were mostly proud and indolent; some killed and ate the cattle given them, sold their tools and abandoned farming—only after repeated instruction did they obey.
translations.idiomatic: But many bannermen were proud and lazy: some slaughtered the cattle issued to them, sold their tools, and left fields untilled—only after repeated admonition did they comply.

sentences.zh: 比去任，凡墾田六萬四千畝。

translations.literal: By the time he left office, altogether 64,000 mu of land had been reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: When he left office, sixty-four thousand mu had been brought under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 寧遠叛兵蒲大芳等譴戍塔爾巴哈台，其黨馬友元等分戍南路諸城。

translations.literal: The Ningyuan rebel soldiers Pu Dafang and others were banished to garrison Tarbagatai; their followers Ma Youyuan and others were distributed to garrison various cities on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: Ningyuan rebels such as Pu Dafang were exiled to Tarbagatai; followers like Ma Youyuan were posted to southern-route garrison towns.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，大芳复謀逆，捕其黨五十餘人誅之。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year Dafang again plotted rebellion; more than fifty of his followers were arrested and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year Dafang plotted rebellion again; over fifty accomplices were arrested and executed.

sentences.zh: 次年，檄調馬友元等百餘人赴伊犁種地，悉斬於途。

translations.literal: The following year he ordered by dispatch that Ma Youyuan and more than a hundred others proceed to Ili to farm land; all were executed on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he summoned Ma Youyuan and more than a hundred others to farm at Ili—and had them all executed en route.

sentences.zh: 詔斥未鞫而殺，失政體，降喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for killing without trial, violating proper governance, and reduced him to Commissioner at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked the killings without trial as a breach of proper governance and demoted him to Kashgar commissioner.

sentences.zh: 复授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 調兩江總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 南河自馬港口墊陷，黃水倒漾，淤運阻漕。

translations.literal: The Southern Canal had subsided at Mapu Harbor; the Yellow River backed up, silted the transport route, and blocked grain tribute.
translations.idiomatic: At Mapu Harbor the Southern Canal had collapsed; Yellow River water backed up, silted the transport channel, and blocked tribute grain.

sentences.zh: 偕河督吳璥察勘海口，請復故道。

translations.literal: Together with Canal Director Wu Jin he surveyed the estuary and requested restoration of the old course.
translations.idiomatic: With canal director Wu Jin he surveyed the estuary and asked to restore the old channel.

sentences.zh: 制疏沙器具，試之河口果驗；

translations.literal: He devised dredging tools; tested at the river mouth they proved effective;
translations.idiomatic: He devised dredging equipment; trials at the estuary proved it effective;

sentences.zh: 又造撥船千艘，改小運船，親駐河干督趲，渡黃回空皆迅速。

translations.literal: he also built a thousand lighter boats, converted small transport vessels, and personally stationed himself on the riverbank to supervise—crossing the Yellow River and returning empty were all swift.
translations.idiomatic: he built a thousand lighters, refitted small transport boats, and personally supervised on the riverbank so Yellow River crossings and empty returns all went swiftly.

sentences.zh: 迭疏論河務，宜引沁入衛，可利漕運。

translations.literal: In repeated memorials on river affairs he argued that diverting the Qin River into the Wei would benefit grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In repeated memorials he argued that bringing the Qin River into the Wei would aid tribute transport.

sentences.zh: 又謂吳璥於黃泥嘴、俞家灘逢灣取直，以致停淤，為璥等論駁。

translations.literal: He also said that at Huangnizui and Yujiatan Wu Jin had cut straight across bends, causing silt to stagnate—refuted by Jin and others.
translations.idiomatic: He also charged that at Huangnizui and Yujiatan Wu Jin had straightened bends and caused silt to stall—charges Jin and others rebutted.

sentences.zh: 复密陳吳璥、徐端所論不實，工程虛捏，自請調任總河察其弊，又薦蔣攸銛、孫玉庭可任。

translations.literal: He again secretly reported that Wu Jin and Xu Duan's claims were false and projects fabricated, asked to be transferred as Director-General of Canals to investigate abuses, and recommended Jiang Youqian and Sun Yuting as capable.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly reported Wu Jin and Xu Duan's claims false and projects inflated, asked transfer as director-general of canals to investigate, and recommended Jiang Youqian and Sun Yuting.

sentences.zh: 帝以鬆筠忠實，治河非所長，用攸銛為河督，責令相助為理。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering Songyun honest and faithful but not expert in river work, appointed Youqian canal director and ordered Songyun to assist.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deemed Songyun honest but no river specialist, made Youqian canal director, and ordered Songyun to assist.

sentences.zh: 尋兼署河督事。

translations.literal: Soon he also acted as canal director.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also acted as canal director.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調兩廣總督，協辦大學士，兼內大臣。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi, made Associate Grand Secretary, and concurrently Grand Minister of the Interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he became governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, associate grand secretary, and grand minister of the interior.

sentences.zh: 召為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命往盛京會勘陵工，兼籌移駐宗室事，疏請小東門外建屋七十所，居閒散宗室七十戶，戶給田三十六畝。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was ordered to Shenyang to jointly survey tomb works and also plan relocating imperial clansmen; he memorialized to build seventy houses outside the Small East Gate for seventy households of idle clansmen, each household granted thirty-six mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was sent to Shenyang to survey tomb works and plan relocating clansmen; he asked for seventy houses outside the Small East Gate for seventy idle clansmen households, thirty-six mu each.

sentences.zh: 又言：「西廠大凌河東有可耕地三千頃，可移駐二千餘戶。

translations.literal: He also stated: "East of the West Factory on the Daliao River there is cultivable land of three thousand qing, where more than two thousand households could be relocated.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "East of the West Factory on the Daliao River lie three thousand qing of arable land, enough for more than two thousand households."

sentences.zh: 東廠週數百里，地多積水，其水自北山柳條邊來，若相地開河，可涸出沃壤；

translations.literal: The East Factory extends for several hundred li with much standing water; the water comes from the Willow Palisade in the northern hills—if canals are opened after surveying the land, fertile soil can be drained forth;
translations.idiomatic: The East Factory spans hundreds of li with much standing water from the northern Willow Palisade hills; proper canal work could drain out rich soil;

sentences.zh: 又東柳河溝亦多積水，若自北山東橫開大渠，可得沃壤數千頃。

translations.literal: the Dongliu River gully also has much standing water; if a great canal is cut eastward across from the northern hills, several thousand qing of fertile land can be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: the Dongliu gully is likewise waterlogged; a major canal eastward from the northern hills could reclaim thousands of qing.

sentences.zh: 」「續勘彰武台邊門外迤西牧廠閒地，橫三四十里，縱六七十里，並可移駐。

translations.literal: "Continuing the survey of idle pasture west of the Zhangwu Platform border gate, thirty to forty li across and sixty to seventy li long—all could receive relocations.
translations.idiomatic: "Further survey west of Zhangwu Platform found pasture idle land thirty to forty li wide and sixty to seventy long—also fit for relocation.

sentences.zh: 請於大凌河西廠東界先試墾種。

translations.literal: He requested trial cultivation first on the eastern border of the West Factory east of the Daliao River.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to begin trial farming on the West Factory's eastern border along the Daliao.

sentences.zh: 」詔並允行。

translations.literal: " Edicts approved all.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne approved all.

sentences.zh: 而試墾事為將軍晉昌奏罷，論者惜之。

translations.literal: But the trial cultivation was stopped by a memorial from General Jin Chang; commentators regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Trial farming was halted by General Jin Chang's memorial, to later regret.

sentences.zh: 回京，授軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he was appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Back in Beijing he was made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 未幾罷，改授御前大臣。

translations.literal: Soon dismissed, he was changed to Grand Minister in Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Soon removed, he became grand minister in attendance.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復出為伊犁將軍，拜東閣大學士，改武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was again sent out as General of Ili, appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, then changed to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Eminence.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he returned as general of Ili, grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, then of the Hall of Military Eminence.

sentences.zh: 以平定滑縣教匪，敘功，加太子太保。

translations.literal: For pacifying the sect rebels at Huaxian, merit was recorded and he was given the additional title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Huaxian sect rebels he was rewarded with senior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 詔偕參贊長齡通籌新疆南北諸城出納，量減內地饋運。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him with Commissioner Chang Ling to plan receipts and disbursements of all cities north and south in Xinjiang and reduce inland supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered with Chang Ling to plan Xinjiang finances north and south and cut inland supply shipments.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「北路塔爾巴哈台歲需內地銀四萬數千兩，南路回疆八城歲需內地銀五萬數千兩，地方貢賦皆入經費之內，無庸議減。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The northern route at Tarbagatai requires more than forty thousand taels annually from the interior; the eight southern Muslim cities require more than fifty thousand—all local tribute and levies enter operating funds and need not be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "Tarbagatai needs over forty thousand taels a year from the interior; the eight southern cities over fifty thousand—local revenue already covers costs and need not be cut.

sentences.zh: 伊犁歲需內地經費銀六十萬兩，可撙節者無幾。

translations.literal: Ili requires six hundred thousand taels of operating funds from the interior annually; little can be economized.
translations.idiomatic: Ili needs six hundred thousand taels yearly from the interior; little can be saved.

sentences.zh: 惟烏魯木齊為新疆腹地，歲需銀一百一十餘萬兩，宜裁減。

translations.literal: Only Urumqi, the heartland of Xinjiang, requiring more than 1.1 million taels annually, should be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Only Urumqi, Xinjiang's core, at over 1.1 million taels a year, should be trimmed.

sentences.zh: 請復屯田，廣墾蘆灘荒地，開採銅鉛各礦，抽收迪化州、吐魯番木稅。

translations.literal: He requested restoration of military colonies, broad reclamation of reed-marsh wasteland, opening copper and lead mines, and collecting timber taxes at Dihua and Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to restore military farms, reclaim reed wasteland, open copper and lead mines, and levy timber taxes at Dihua and Turfan.

sentences.zh: 」又議綠營糧餉，凡倉儲充裕處，改給銀米各半，並復乾隆四十六年以前捐監之例，使邊地就近納粟。

translations.literal: " He also discussed Green Standard Army rations: wherever granaries were ample, pay half in silver and half in grain, and restore the pre-Qianlong 46 purchase-by-examination rule so the frontier could deliver grain nearby.
translations.idiomatic: " He also proposed Green Standard rations: where stores were ample, half silver and half grain, and restoring pre-Qianlong 46 grain purchase rules for nearby delivery.

sentences.zh: 所議或行或不行，於內地歲輸卒未大減。

translations.literal: Some proposals were adopted, some not; annual shipments from the interior were ultimately not greatly reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Some plans were adopted, some not; inland shipments were barely reduced.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾阿奇木伯克玉努斯聽其妻色奇納言，多不法，私與浩罕酋愛瑪爾交通。

translations.literal: The Kashgar Akim Beg Yunus listened to his wife Sekina and committed many illegal acts, privately communicating with the Kokand chief Aimair.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar akim beg Yunus obeyed his wife Sekina in many unlawful acts and dealt secretly with Kokand chief Aimair.

sentences.zh: 愛瑪爾欲使尊為汗，遣使請自設哈子伯克，用浩罕稅例徵安集延商。

translations.literal: Aimair wished to have him honored as khan, sent envoys requesting to appoint his own Khazi Beg, and levy Kokand tax rates on Andijan merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Aimair wanted him recognized as khan, asked to appoint a Khazi beg, and tax Andijan merchants by Kokand rates.

sentences.zh: 十九年，松筠巡視回疆，誅色奇納，械玉努斯，禁錮伊犁；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Songyun toured the Muslim borderlands, executed Sekina, shackled Yunus, and imprisoned him at Ili;
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Songyun toured the Muslim territories, executed Sekina, shackled Yunus, and imprisoned him at Ili;

sentences.zh: 拒浩罕之請，斥去其使。

translations.literal: he refused Kokand's requests and expelled its envoys.
translations.idiomatic: he refused Kokand and expelled its envoys.

sentences.zh: 二十年，喀什噶爾回人仔牙敦作亂，親往治之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Kashgar Muslim Ziyadun rebelled; he went in person to deal with it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Kashgar Muslim Ziyadun rebelled; Songyun went in person.

sentences.zh: 仔牙敦就獲，與布魯特比圖爾第邁莫特並置極刑。

translations.literal: Ziyadun was captured and, together with the Kirghiz chief Tuturdi Maimote, subjected to extreme punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyadun was captured and, with Kirghiz chief Tuturdi Maimote, executed.

sentences.zh: 詔斥松筠不待命，削宮銜，召還京。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Songyun for not awaiting orders, stripped his court rank, and recalled him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked him for acting without orders, stripped rank, and recalled him.

sentences.zh: 松筠初任時，築四堡於伊犁河北，議移置八旗散丁，事未竟而去。

translations.literal: When Songyun first took office he built four forts north of the Ili River and planned to relocate scattered banner households; the matter was unfinished when he left.
translations.idiomatic: On his first tour he built four forts north of the Ili River to resettle scattered banner households but left before finishing.

sentences.zh: 再至，乃築室堡中，堡置百戶，戶授田三四十畝，三時務農，冬則肄武。

translations.literal: On returning he built houses within the forts, each fort holding a hundred households, each household granted thirty to forty mu; three seasons for farming, winter for military drill.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he built housing in the forts—hundred households each, thirty to forty mu per household, farming three seasons and drilling in winter.

sentences.zh: 規畫粗備，以屬代者，而代者不置意，田遂荒。

translations.literal: The plan was roughly complete and left to his successor, but the successor paid no attention and the fields fell waste.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was largely ready for his successor, who ignored it, and the fields went fallow.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，詔來年幸盛京，抗疏諫阻，罷大學士，出為察哈爾都統，署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year an edict announced an imperial tour of Shenyang the next year; he submitted a remonstrance in opposition, was dismissed as grand secretary, and sent out as Chahar commander and acting general of Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, when a Shenyang tour was announced, he remonstrated, lost his grand secretary post, and was sent as Chahar commander and acting Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 逾年，子熙昌歿，帝憐之，召還為正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: More than a year later his son Xichang died; the emperor pitied him and recalled him as commander of the Plain White Banner Chinese forces.
translations.idiomatic: A year later his son Xichang died; the emperor pitied him and recalled him as Plain White Banner Chinese commander.

sentences.zh: 尋授禮部尚書，調兵部，复御前兼職。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Minister of Rites, transferred to the Ministry of War, and again given concurrent attendance duties.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was minister of rites, then war, again with attendance duties.

sentences.zh: 未幾，出為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as General of Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent out as Shenyang general.

sentences.zh: 松筠素以忠諒見重，在朝時，凡燕遊執御之事，乘間直言無避。

translations.literal: Songyun had long been valued for loyalty and candor; while at court, whenever there were banquets or imperial outings he seized opportunities to speak frankly without avoidance.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun was valued for loyalty and candor; at court he spoke frankly on banquets and outings without holding back.

sentences.zh: 既屢忤旨，二十五年，以兵部遺失行印，追論，降山海關副都統。

translations.literal: Having repeatedly offended the throne, in the twenty-fifth year, because the Ministry of War lost its traveling seal, past offenses were pursued and he was reduced to vice commander at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated clashes with the throne, in the twenty-fifth year the War Ministry lost its traveling seal; past faults were pursued and he was demoted to Shanhaiguan vice commander.

sentences.zh: 復以事，迭降為驍騎校。

translations.literal: Again on account of other matters he was successively reduced to commandant of the Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Further incidents reduced him step by step to vanguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，仁宗崩於熱河，梓宮回京，宣宗步行於班僚中見之，扶而哭，翌日授左副都御史，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: That autumn Emperor Renzong died at Rehe; as the coffin returned to the capital, the Daoguang Emperor walking among the officials saw him, supported him and wept, and the next day appointed him Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, then promoted him Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Renzong died at Rehe; as the coffin returned, Daoguang walking among officials saw him, held him and wept, and next day made him left vice censor-in-chief, then left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 其復起也，甚負時望，然卒不安於位，未一月，出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: His restoration aroused great public expectation, yet he still could not keep his post; within a month he was sent out as Commander at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: His return raised high hopes, yet within a month he was sent out as Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，召授兵部尚書，調吏部，復為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was summoned as Minister of War, transferred to Personnel, and again made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he was recalled as war minister, moved to personnel, and again grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 二年，暫署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the second year he temporarily acted as Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 he briefly governed Zhili.

sentences.zh: 以代改理籓院奏稿，忤尚書禧恩，被劾，降六部員外郎。

translations.literal: For altering a Court of Colonial Affairs memorial draft on another's behalf, he offended Minister Xi En, was impeached, and reduced to sixth-rank department director.
translations.idiomatic: Altering a Colonial Affairs draft for someone else offended Xi En; impeached, he was reduced to sixth-rank director.

sentences.zh: 尋授光祿寺卿，遷左都御史。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and promoted Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was director of imperial sacrifices, then left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 又出為盛京將軍，調吉林。

translations.literal: Again sent out as General of Shenyang, then transferred to Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Again Shenyang general, then Jilin.

sentences.zh: 數年之中，兩召還朝，為左都御史、禮部尚書；

translations.literal: Within several years he was twice recalled to court as Left Censor-in-Chief and Minister of Rites;
translations.idiomatic: Within years he was twice recalled as left censor-in-chief and minister of rites;

sentences.zh: 迭出署烏里雅蘇台將軍、熱河都統、直隸總督。

translations.literal: and repeatedly sent out to act as General of Uliasutai, Commander at Rehe, and Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: and repeatedly sent to act as Uliasutai general, Rehe commander, and Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九年，調兵部尚書，往科布多鞫獄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Minister of War and sent to Kobdo to conduct trials.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became war minister and went to Kobdo to judge cases.

sentences.zh: 十年，往山西按巡撫徐炘被控事。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he went to Shanxi to investigate charges against Governor Xu Xin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he went to Shanxi to investigate Governor Xu Xin.

sentences.zh: 回疆方用兵，密疏有所論列，詔令陳善後方略，多被採納。

translations.literal: The Muslim borderlands were at war; in a secret memorial he set forth proposals; an edict ordered him to state postwar strategy, and many points were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: With war in the Muslim territories he wrote a secret memorial; ordered to propose postwar policy, much was adopted.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，自以衰病請罷，數日復請任使，詔斥進退自由，負優禮大臣之意。

translations.literal: That autumn, claiming age and illness he asked to retire; days later he again asked for appointment; an edict rebuked his freedom to come and go as betraying the court's gracious treatment of senior ministers.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he pleaded age and illness to retire, then days later asked for duty again; the throne rebuked such coming and going as unworthy of favored ministers.

sentences.zh: 又以前赴科布多囑道員徐寅代購什物，罷職，予三品頂戴休致。

translations.literal: Also because on the Kobdo trip he had a circuit intendant Xu Yin purchase goods for him, he was dismissed, granted third-rank button, and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Because on the Kobdo trip he had intendant Xu Yin buy goods for him, he was dismissed with third-rank button and retired.

sentences.zh: 至十二年，浩罕遣使進表，松筠曾言浩罕通商，邊境可靖，帝思其言，复頭品頂戴，署正黃旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: By the twelfth year Kokand sent envoys with a tribute memorial; Songyun had once said trade with Kokand would quiet the frontier—the emperor recalled his words, restored his original third-rank button, and appointed him acting vice commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese forces.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth year Kokand sent tribute; remembering Songyun's claim that Kokand trade would pacify the border, the emperor restored his third-rank button and made him acting Bordered Yellow vice commander.

sentences.zh: 命赴歸化城勘達爾漢、茂明安、土默特三部爭地，據乾隆朝圖記判定，三部皆悅服。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Guihua City to survey land disputes among the Darhan, Maominggan, and Tumed banners; judging by Qianlong maps, all three were satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: At Guihua he settled land disputes among Darhan, Maominggan, and Tumed by Qianlong maps; all three accepted.

sentences.zh: 還，授理籓院侍郎，調工部，進正藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On return he was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, transferred to Works, and advanced to commander of the Plain Blue Mongol Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Returning, he was Colonial Affairs vice minister, then works minister, then Plain Blue Mongol commander.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以都統銜休致。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he retired with commander's rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he retired with commander rank.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，年八十有二，贈太子太保，依尚書例賜卹，諡文清，祀伊犁名宦祠。

translations.literal: More than a year later he died at eighty-two; posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, condolence payments by ministerial precedent, posthumous title Wenqing, enshrined in Ili's shrine of eminent officials.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he died at eighty-two; posthumously senior guardian of the heir apparent, ministerial mourning grants, posthumous title Wenqing, enshrined at Ili.

sentences.zh: 松筠廉直坦易，脫略文法，不隨時俯仰，屢起屢蹶。

translations.literal: Songyun was upright, frank, and easygoing, careless of formalities, unwilling to bow to the times, and rose and fell repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun was upright, frank, and informal, unwilling to bend with fashion, and rose and fell many times.

sentences.zh: 晚年益多挫折，剛果不克如前，實心為國，未嘗改也。

translations.literal: In later years setbacks grew; his firmness could not match earlier days, yet his sincere devotion to the state never changed.
translations.idiomatic: Late in life setbacks multiplied and his vigor faded, yet his sincere service never changed.

sentences.zh: 服膺宋儒，亦喜談禪。

translations.literal: He revered Song Neo-Confucians and also delighted in discussing Chan.
translations.idiomatic: He revered Song Neo-Confucianism and also loved Chan talk.

sentences.zh: 尤施惠貧民，名滿海內，要以治邊功最多。

translations.literal: He was especially generous to the poor; his name filled the realm, though his greatest achievements lay in governing the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially kind to the poor; famed nationwide, his greatest work was on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 子熙昌，以廕生官至刑、工兩部侍郎，署熱河都統兼護軍統領。

translations.literal: His son Xichang, through hereditary privilege rising to vice minister in both Punishments and Works, acted as Commander at Rehe and concurrently protected the army command.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xichang, by hereditary privilege rose to punishments and works vice minister, acting Rehe commander and army protector.

sentences.zh: 數奉使赴各省按事，亦被信用。

translations.literal: He was several times sent on imperial commission to investigate affairs in various provinces and was also trusted.
translations.idiomatic: He was often sent to provinces on imperial commissions and was trusted.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十三年，卒於長沙，帝深惜之，贈都統，諡敬慎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiaqing he died at Changsha; the emperor deeply regretted it, posthumously made him commander, posthumous title Jingjin.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 23 he died at Changsha; the emperor mourned him, posthumously made him commander with posthumous title Jingjin.

sentences.zh: 富俊，字松岩，卓特氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Jun, style name Songyan, of the Zhuote clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun, styled Songyan, of the Zhuote clan, was a Bordered Yellow Mongol bannerman.

sentences.zh: 繙譯進士，授禮部主事，歷郎中。

translations.literal: A translation jinshi, he was appointed a director in the Ministry of Rites and rose through the ranks to department director.
translations.idiomatic: A translation jinshi, he was a Rites director and rose to department director.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣蒙古侍讀學士、內閣學士，兼副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Mongol Reader in the Grand Secretariat, Grand Secretary, concurrently vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Mongol reader in the Secretariat, grand secretary, and vice commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，擢兵部侍郎，充科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted Vice Minister of War and appointed Commissioner at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he became war vice minister and Kobdo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年，授烏魯木齊都統，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed Commander at Urumqi, then transferred to Commissioner at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was Urumqi commander, then Kashgar commissioner.

sentences.zh: 歷葉爾羌辦事大臣、烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He served as Commissioner in Charge at Yarkand and Commissioner at Uliasutai.
translations.idiomatic: He served at Yarkand and Uliasutai.

sentences.zh: 召署鑲紅旗漢軍都統、兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Recalled, he acted as commander of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese forces and Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he acted as Bordered Red Chinese commander and war vice minister.

sentences.zh: 八年，出為吉林將軍，調盛京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was sent out as General of Jilin, then transferred to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was Jilin general, then Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 清治民典旗地，限年首官，不首者治罪，追典價租息入官。

translations.literal: A Qing regulation required banner people who mortgaged land to civilians to report at the start of the year; failure to report was punishable and mortgage price, rent, and interest were confiscated to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Qing rules required bannermen who mortgaged land to civilians to report yearly; otherwise they were punished and mortgage payments and interest seized.

sentences.zh: 富俊疏言：「一年之內，一千六百餘案，應追繳者不下萬人，年久轉典，株連繁多。

translations.literal: Fu Jun memorialized: "Within one year there were more than 1,600 cases; those who should repay number no fewer than ten thousand; with years of successive mortgages the entanglements are many.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun wrote: "In one year there were over 1,600 cases involving nearly ten thousand people to be pursued; years of sub-mortgages entangled many."

sentences.zh: 旗、民多窮苦，既獲罪，又迫追呼，情實可憫，請悉寬免。

translations.literal: Banner people and civilians are mostly poor; having been convicted they are again pressed for payment—the situation is truly pitiable; I request complete remission.
translations.idiomatic: Bannermen and civilians are mostly poor; convicted, they face collection—the case is pitiable; I ask full remission."

sentences.zh: 」允之。

translations.literal: " This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " This was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二年，考覈軍政，以潔己奉公，邊陲安輯，特詔褒美，予議敘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, reviewing military administration, for integrity in office and quieting the frontier, a special edict praised him and ordered consideration of rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year his military review won special praise for integrity and pacifying the frontier, with rewards ordered.

sentences.zh: 十五年，因採葠攙雜，受屬員蔽，褫職，遣往吉林效力。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because ginseng was adulterated and he was deceived by subordinates, he was stripped of office and sent to serve at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year adulterated ginseng and deception by subordinates cost him his post; he was sent to serve at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 既而言官論關東三省賭博風熾，仁宗念富俊在官時曾嚴禁，即起授盛京工部侍郎，兼管奉天府尹及六邊邊門事務。

translations.literal: When censors discussed rampant gambling in the three eastern provinces, Emperor Renzong, recalling Fu Jun's strict prohibition while in office, immediately restored him as Works Vice Minister at Shenyang, concurrently administering the Fengtian prefect and six frontier gates.
translations.idiomatic: When censors decried gambling in the northeast, Renzong recalled Fu Jun's strict ban and restored him as Shenyang works vice minister overseeing Fengtian and six frontier gates.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授黑龍江將軍，疏請內外臣工三年更調，及禁奢、講武數事，詔以更調非可限年，餘並嘉納。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed General of Heilongjiang; he memorialized that inner and outer officials should rotate every three years and on forbidding luxury and promoting military drill—an edict said rotation could not be fixed by years but approved the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he became Heilongjiang general and proposed three-year rotations, bans on luxury, and military drill—the throne rejected fixed rotation but approved the rest.

sentences.zh: 又以東三省官兵技藝優嫺，每屆五年挑送京營，著為令。

translations.literal: Because northeastern troops were skilled, every five years the best were selected for the capital garrisons—made a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Because northeastern troops were skilled, the best were sent to capital garrisons every five years—codified as regulation.

sentences.zh: 十九年，調吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 先是，議籌八旗生計，詔勘吉林荒地開墾，移駐京旗，將軍賽衝阿言拉林近地閒荒可墾，未有規畫。

translations.literal: Earlier, in planning livelihoods for the Eight Banners, an edict ordered survey of wasteland in Jilin for reclamation and relocation of capital banner households; General Saichonga said idle land near Lalin could be cultivated, but there was as yet no plan.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, planning banner livelihoods, the court ordered Jilin wasteland surveyed for reclamation and relocating capital banner households; General Saichonga said land near Lalin could be farmed, but no plan existed.

sentences.zh: 富俊至，疏言：「乾隆中移駐京旗，建屋墾地，多藉吉林兵力，墾而不種，酌留數人教耕，一年後裁汰。

translations.literal: When Fu Jun arrived he memorialized: "When capital banner households were relocated in Qianlong, houses were built and land reclaimed largely with Jilin troops; land was reclaimed but not planted—only a few were kept to teach farming and dismissed after a year.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun wrote: "Under Qianlong, relocating capital banner households used Jilin labor to build and clear land, but little was planted—only a few instructors were kept a year.

sentences.zh: 京旗蘇拉不能耕作，始而僱覓流民，久之田為民有，殊失國家愛育旗人之意。

translations.literal: Capital banner bondservants could not farm; at first they hired vagrant civilians, and in time the fields became civilian property—far from the state's intent to cherish banner people.
translations.idiomatic: Capital banner bondservants could not farm; they hired civilians until the land became civilian holdings—defeating the state's care for bannermen.

sentences.zh: 今籌試墾，莫若先辦屯田。

translations.literal: In planning trial reclamation now, nothing is better than first establishing military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: For trial reclamation, military colonies should come first.

sentences.zh: 請發吉林閒散旗人一千名為屯丁，每丁給銀二十五兩、耔種二石，官置牛具，人給荒地三十晌。

translations.literal: He requested dispatch of a thousand idle bannermen from Jilin as colonists; each would receive twenty-five taels, two shi of seed, government oxen and tools, and thirty shang of wasteland per man.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for a thousand idle Jilin bannermen as colonists, each with twenty-five taels, two shi of seed, government oxen and tools, and thirty shang of wasteland.

sentences.zh: 墾種二十晌，留荒十晌，四年徵糧，每晌一石。

translations.literal: Twenty shang would be planted and ten left waste; after four years grain tax would be collected at one shi per shang.
translations.idiomatic: They would farm twenty shang and leave ten waste; after four years tax would be one shi per shang.

sentences.zh: 十年後移駐京旗，人給熟地十五晌，荒五晌，餘十晌荒、熟各半，給原駐屯丁為忄互產，免徵其租。

translations.literal: After ten years capital banner households would be relocated, each given fifteen shang of mature land and five of waste; the remaining ten shang half mature and half waste would be given the original colonists as permanent property, rent-free.
translations.idiomatic: After ten years capital households would relocate, each getting fifteen shang mature and five waste; ten shang half mature would become permanent property for the original colonists, rent-free.

sentences.zh: 因利而利，糜帑無多，將來京旗移到，得種熟地，與本處旗屯犬牙相錯，學耕夥種，實為有益。

translations.literal: Profiting through profit, little treasury would be spent; when capital households arrived they would gain mature fields interspersed with local banner colonies, learning to farm together—truly beneficial.
translations.idiomatic: With modest expense, capital households would gain mature fields mingled with local colonies and learn joint farming—clear benefit.

sentences.zh: 」並詳列屯墾、出納、設官、經理事宜，詔如議行。

translations.literal: " He also detailed colonization accounts, officials, and administration; an edict approved implementation as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: " He detailed colonization, finances, officials, and administration; the throne approved.

sentences.zh: 二十年，富俊親駐雙城子，地在拉林河西北，橫一百三十里，縱七十餘裡，沃衍宜耕。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Fu Jun personally stationed at Shuangchengzi, northwest of the Lalin River, one hundred thirty li across and more than seventy long, fertile and fit for farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Fu Jun personally oversaw Shuangchengzi, northwest of the Lalin River—130 by 70 li of fertile land.

sentences.zh: 遣員履丈，分撥伐木於拉林河上游，建立屯屋。

translations.literal: He sent officials to measure the land and allocate logging upstream on the Lalin to build colony houses.
translations.idiomatic: Officials measured the land and allocated logging on the upper Lalin to build colony housing.

sentences.zh: 分五屯，設協領一、佐領二，分左右翼統治之，即名屯地曰雙城堡，於二十一年一律開墾。

translations.literal: Five colonies were divided, with one assistant commander and two colonels governing left and right wings; the colony lands were named Shuangcheng Fort, all opened in the twenty-first year.
translations.idiomatic: Five colonies were set with one assistant commander and two colonels for left and right wings; the settlement was named Shuangcheng Fort and opened in the twenty-first year.

sentences.zh: 是年霜早歉收，屯丁僅足餬口，又挈妻子者不敷居住，間有逃亡。

translations.literal: That year early frost brought poor harvest; colonists barely had enough to eat; those who brought wives and children lacked housing, and some fled.
translations.idiomatic: Early frost that year left colonists barely fed; families lacked housing and some fled.

sentences.zh: 乃展緩徵糧一年，添蓋窩棚，借給耔種，心始安。

translations.literal: Grain tax was deferred one year, huts were added, and seed lent until minds were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Tax was deferred a year, huts added, and seed lent until order returned.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，調盛京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Shenyang.

sentences.zh: 疏陳雙城堡餘荒尚多，續發盛京、吉林旗丁各千名往墾，分左、右二屯，舊屯名為中屯，遂復調富俊吉林，任其事。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Shuangcheng Fort still had much surplus waste; another thousand bannermen each from Shenyang and Jilin were sent to reclaim, divided into left and right colonies with the old colony as central—Fu Jun was again transferred to Jilin to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: He reported much waste remained at Shuangcheng Fort; another thousand bannermen each from Shenyang and Jilin were sent, forming left and right colonies with the old as central—and Fu Jun returned to Jilin to manage it.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，先到屯丁千名，盛京旗人多有親族偕來，自原入屯，惟隸寧古塔者，因近地亦可耕荒，不原輕離鄉土，聽其還，以空額二百名改撥盛京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the first thousand colonists arrived; many Shenyang bannermen brought relatives into the original colonies; only those under Ningguta, because nearby land could also be reclaimed, would not leave home—they were allowed to return and two hundred vacancies were reassigned to Shenyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the first thousand arrived; Shenyang bannermen often brought kin; Ningguta men, able to farm nearby, stayed home—two hundred slots went to Shenyang instead.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，复續到千名。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year another thousand arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year another thousand arrived.

sentences.zh: 富俊巡曆三屯，疏陳：「比屋環居，安土樂業，有井田遺風。

translations.literal: Fu Jun toured the three colonies and reported: "Houses cluster in rings; people are content—there is a trace of well-field antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun toured three colonies and wrote: "Homes ring together; people are settled—a trace of well-field order.

sentences.zh: 中屯開墾在先，麥苗暢發，男耕婦饁，俱極勤勞。

translations.literal: The central colony was opened first; wheat flourished and men plowed while women brought food—all extremely industrious.
translations.idiomatic: The central colony opened first; wheat thrived and men plowed while women brought meals—all very industrious.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗大悅，報曰：「滿洲故里，佃田宅宅，洵善事也。

translations.literal: " Emperor Renzong was greatly pleased and replied: "The Manchu homeland, farming fields and building homes—truly a fine deed.
translations.idiomatic: " Renzong was delighted: "In the Manchu homeland, farming and building homes—truly fine.

sentences.zh: 」續議三屯應增事宜，詔嘉實心任事，予議敘。

translations.literal: " Further discussion of additions for the three colonies won praise for sincere service and orders for reward consideration.
translations.idiomatic: " Further plans for the three colonies won praise for sincere service and reward consideration.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，疏言：「三屯開墾九萬數千晌，已著成效，可移駐京旗三千戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he memorialized: "The three colonies have opened more than ninety thousand shang with clear results; three thousand capital banner households can be relocated.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 he wrote: "Three colonies have opened over ninety thousand shang with clear success; three thousand capital households can relocate.

sentences.zh: 請自道光四年始，每歲移駐二百戶，給資裝車馬，分起送屯，官給房屋牛具。

translations.literal: From the fourth year of Daoguang, two hundred households each year should be relocated with travel funds and carts, sent in groups to colonies with government houses and oxen.
translations.idiomatic: From Daoguang 4, two hundred households a year should relocate with travel funds, carts, and government housing and oxen.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 二年，召授理籓院尚書，與玉瀾堂十五老臣宴，御製詩有「勤勞三省，不凋松柏」之褒。

translations.literal: In the second year he was summoned as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and banqueted with the fifteen elders of the Jade Wave Hall; an imperial poem praised diligent service in three provinces, like an unfading pine and cypress.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he became Colonial Affairs minister and banqueted with the fifteen Jade Wave Hall elders; an imperial poem praised his diligence in three provinces.

sentences.zh: 四年，復出為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was again sent out as General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was again Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 方雙城堡之興屯也，富俊欲推其法於伯都訥圍場，以旗戶往往賴幫丁助耕，不如迳招民墾。

translations.literal: When Shuangcheng Fort colonies were begun, Fu Jun wished to extend the method to the Boduna hunting grounds, since banner households often relied on hired helpers to farm—better to recruit civilians directly.
translations.idiomatic: When Shuangcheng Fort began, Fu Jun wanted the same for Boduna grounds, where bannermen relied on hired labor—better to recruit civilians.

sentences.zh: 前後疏六七上，為廷議所格。

translations.literal: Six or seven memorials before and after were blocked by court debate.
translations.idiomatic: Six or seven memorials were blocked in court debate.

sentences.zh: 至是，復言伯都訥圍場荒地二十餘萬晌，募民屯墾，較雙城堡費半功倍，始允之。

translations.literal: At this time he again said Boduna hunting grounds had more than two hundred thousand shang of waste; recruiting civilians to colonize would cost half what Shuangcheng Fort did—approval came at last.
translations.idiomatic: He again said Boduna had over two hundred thousand shang of waste; civilian colonization would cost half Shuangcheng Fort—and won approval.

sentences.zh: 五年，丈地分屯，申畫經界，名曰新城屯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year land was measured, boundaries drawn, and the settlement named New City Colony.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year land was surveyed, boundaries fixed, and the site named New City Colony.

sentences.zh: 分八旗為兩翼，每翼初立二十五屯，後定為十五屯。

translations.literal: The Eight Banners were divided into two wings; each wing first had twenty-five colonies, later fixed at fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Banners split into two wings, each first with twenty-five colonies, later fifteen.

sentences.zh: 每屯三十戶，以「治本於​​農務滋稼穡」八字為號。

translations.literal: Each colony thirty households, numbered by the eight characters governing the root in farming to nourish the grain.
translations.idiomatic: Each colony had thirty households, named by the phrase governing the root in farming to nourish grain.

sentences.zh: 以次撥地，同時並墾。

translations.literal: Land was allocated in sequence and reclaimed together.
translations.idiomatic: Land was allocated in turn and reclaimed together.

sentences.zh: 至七年，陸續認佃三千六百戶，總為一百二十屯，與雙城堡相為表裡。

translations.literal: By the seventh year 3,600 households had registered, totaling 120 colonies, complementing Shuangcheng Fort.
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh year 3,600 households formed 120 colonies alongside Shuangcheng Fort.
