sentences.zh: 初議京旗每歲二百戶移駐雙城堡，至六年，僅陸續移到二百七十戶；

translations.literal: Originally two hundred capital households a year were to move to Shuangcheng Fort; by the sixth year only 270 had arrived in succession;
translations.idiomatic: Originally two hundred capital households a year were to move to Shuangcheng Fort; by the sixth year only 270 had arrived;

sentences.zh: 七年，續移八十五戶：而地利頓興，自此雙城堡、伯都訥兩地號邊方繁庶之區焉。

translations.literal: in the seventh year another eighty-five: yet the land flourished, and from then Shuangcheng Fort and Boduna were called the prosperous border regions.
translations.idiomatic: in the seventh year another eighty-five; still the land prospered, and both became famed prosperous borderlands.

sentences.zh: 墾事既定，復召為理籓院尚書，協辦大學士，兼鑲黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: With colonization settled he was again summoned as Minister of Colonial Affairs, Associate Grand Secretary, and commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese forces.
translations.idiomatic: Colonization done, he was again Colonial Affairs minister, associate grand secretary, and Bordered Yellow Chinese commander.

sentences.zh: 次年，京察，以在吉林宣勞，予議敘。

translations.literal: The next year in capital review, for proclaiming merit in Jilin, reward was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Next year capital review ordered reward for his Jilin service.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「京、外競尚浮奢，官民服飾及冠婚、喪祭，任意踰制，有關風俗人心。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Capital and provinces alike compete in extravagance; official and popular dress and rites of capping, marriage, and mourning exceed regulations at will—this affects custom and public mind.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote that capital and provinces competed in luxury, with dress and rites exceeding regulations—affecting morals.

sentences.zh: 請依會典儀制，刊布規條，宣諭民間。

translations.literal: Please follow the collected statutes and ritual codes, publish rules, and proclaim them to the people.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to publish rules from the statutes and proclaim them.

sentences.zh: 」詔下有司議行。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered local officials to discuss implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " Local officials were ordered to implement.

sentences.zh: 時富俊年逾八十，渥被優禮，遇常朝免其入直。

translations.literal: Fu Jun was then over eighty and richly favored; for regular audiences he was excused from attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Over eighty and richly favored, he was excused regular attendance.

sentences.zh: 迭讞獄盛京、吉林，俱稱旨。

translations.literal: Repeatedly judging cases in Shenyang and Jilin, he always met the imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: Judging cases in Shenyang and Jilin, he always pleased the throne.

sentences.zh: 十年，調工部，拜東閣大學士，管理理籓院。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Works, appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, and placed in charge of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became works minister, Eastern Pavilion grand secretary, and head of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二年，復請禁僭用服色，犯者拿捕，詔斥徒滋擾累，寢其議。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he again asked to forbid usurping forbidden colors and arrest violators; an edict rebuked this as mere harassment and shelved the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he again sought bans on forbidden dress colors; the throne called it harassment and dropped it.

sentences.zh: 尋以天時亢旱，自稱奉職無狀，引年乞罷，不許。

translations.literal: Soon, because of severe drought, he said he had failed in duty and asked to retire on age; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: During drought he confessed failure and asked to retire; refused.

sentences.zh: 授內大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior.
translations.idiomatic: He was made grand minister of the interior.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「科舉保薦，並認師生，餽遺關通，成為陋習。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In metropolitan examinations and recommendations, teacher-student ties are recognized and gifts and favor-trading have become base custom.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote that examinations and recommendations were corrupted by teacher-student favor and gifts.

sentences.zh: 請嚴禁，以端仕進。

translations.literal: I request strict prohibition to rectify advancement in office.
translations.idiomatic: He asked strict prohibition to clean up advancement.

sentences.zh: 」詔嘉納，申誡臣工務除積習。

translations.literal: " The edict praised and accepted this and admonished all officials to remove entrenched habits.
translations.idiomatic: " Praised and accepted, with orders to officials to end bad habits.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 帝悼惜，稱其「清慎公勤，克盡厥職」，贈太子太傅，親臨奠醊，諡文誠，入祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: The emperor mourned him, saying he was "pure, cautious, public-spirited, and diligent, fully performing his duties," posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, personally offered libation, posthumous title Wencheng, enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him as "pure, cautious, diligent, and dutiful," posthumously grand tutor, libation in person, posthumous title Wencheng, enshrined among worthy officials.

sentences.zh: 富俊尚廉節，好禮賢士。

translations.literal: Fu Jun valued integrity and loved to honor worthy scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun valued integrity and honored scholars.

sentences.zh: 在吉林時，請調黑龍江戍員馬瑞辰掌教白山書院，且被嚴斥。

translations.literal: In Jilin he asked to transfer Heilongjiang garrison officer Ma Ruichen to head Baishan Academy and was sternly rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: In Jilin he sought Ma Ruichen from Heilongjiang for Baishan Academy and was sternly rebuked.

sentences.zh: 其治屯墾，專任竇心傳，卒以成功。

translations.literal: In managing colonization he relied solely on Dou Xinchuan and ultimately succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Colonization he entrusted solely to Dou Xinchuan and succeeded.

sentences.zh: 心傳，山西人。

translations.literal: Xinchuan was a native of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xinchuan was from Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 以進士官奉天寧海知縣，坐東巡治御道有誤，罷職。

translations.literal: As a jinshi he became magistrate of Ninghai in Fengtian; for errors in preparing the imperial road on an eastern tour he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi, he was Ninghai magistrate in Fengtian; dismissed for errors on an eastern tour road.

sentences.zh: 富俊知其才，闢佐墾務，規畫悉出手定，始終在事，以勞复官。

translations.literal: Fu Jun knew his talent, recruited him for colonization—all plans were his handiwork; he remained throughout and was restored to office for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jun knew his talent, used him for colonization—all plans were his; he stayed throughout and was restored for merit.

sentences.zh: 世比諸陳潢之佐靳輔治河。

translations.literal: The age compared him to Chen Huang assisting Jin Fu in river control.
translations.idiomatic: He was compared to Chen Huang assisting Jin Fu on rivers.

sentences.zh: 博啟圖，一等誠嘉毅勇公明瑞孫。

translations.literal: Bo Qitu was grandson of Mingrui, first-rank Duke of Sincere, Commendable, Resolute, and Brave.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Qitu was grandson of first-rank Duke Mingrui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初襲爵，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In early Jiaqing he inherited the title and was appointed first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In early Jiaqing he inherited the title and became first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 歷兵部侍郎、察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: He served as Vice Minister of War and Chahar commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was war vice minister and Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 道光七年，調吉林將軍，繼富俊之後，守其成規。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Daoguang he was transferred to General of Jilin, succeeding Fu Jun and keeping his established rules.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 7 he became Jilin general after Fu Jun and kept his rules.

sentences.zh: 治邊有法，富俊請以屯墾專任之。

translations.literal: He governed the frontier effectively; Fu Jun had asked that colonization be his sole charge.
translations.idiomatic: He governed the border well; Fu Jun had wanted colonization solely his charge.

sentences.zh: 時京旗以邊地早寒，又助耕乏人，原往者少。

translations.literal: At the time capital banner households, because the border was cold early and helpers scarce, were reluctant to go.
translations.idiomatic: Capital bannermen shunned the cold border and scarce labor and were reluctant to go.

sentences.zh: 博啟圖疏請減戶增田，許其買僕代耕，統居中屯，改建住屋，俾便禦寒；

translations.literal: Bo Qitu memorialized to reduce households and increase land per household, allow purchased servants to farm in their stead, concentrate them in the central colony, and rebuild houses for warmth;
translations.idiomatic: Bo Qitu asked fewer households with more land, servants to farm for them, central colony concentration, and warmer housing;

sentences.zh: 雖得請，尋召授工部尚書兼領侍衛內大臣，繼任者不果行其議，故移駐卒未如額。

translations.literal: though approved, he was soon summoned as Minister of Works with concurrent chief bodyguard duties; his successor did not carry out the plan, so relocation never reached the quota.
translations.idiomatic: approved, but soon summoned as works minister and chief bodyguard; his successor did not act, so relocation fell short.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒，贈太子太保，諡敬僖。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died; posthumously Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, posthumous title Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he died, posthumously senior guardian with posthumous title Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：保寧、松筠、富俊並出自籓族，久膺邊寄，晉綸扉，稱名相，伊犁、吉林屯田，利在百世；

translations.literal: The commentary says: Bao Ning, Songyun, and Fu Jun all came from frontier clans, long held border posts, rose to the Grand Secretariat, and were famed ministers; Ili and Jilin military colonies benefit a hundred generations;
translations.idiomatic: The commentary: Bao Ning, Songyun, and Fu Jun came from frontier clans, long held border posts, reached the Grand Secretariat, and were famed ministers; Ili and Jilin colonies benefit generations;

sentences.zh: 然限於事勢，收效未盡如所規畫，甚矣締造之艱也！

translations.literal: yet constrained by circumstances, results did not fully match their plans—how arduous was the founding of the realm!
translations.idiomatic: yet circumstances limited them and results fell short of plans—how hard the founding was!

sentences.zh: 松筠在吉林，請開小綏芬屯墾，當時以不急之務沮之；

translations.literal: Songyun in Jilin requested opening Xiaosuifen for colonization, then blocked as non-urgent;
translations.idiomatic: Songyun in Jilin asked to open Xiaosuifen for colonization but was blocked as non-urgent;

sentences.zh: 至咸、同間，其地竟劃歸俄界。

translations.literal: by the Xianfeng and Tongzhi eras the land was ceded to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: by Xianfeng and Tongzhi it was ceded to Russia.

sentences.zh: 苟早經營，奚致輕棄？

translations.literal: Had it been developed early, how could it have been lightly abandoned?
translations.idiomatic: Had it been developed earlier, how could it have been abandoned?

sentences.zh: 實邊之計，顧可忽哉！

translations.literal: Plans to solidify the frontier—how can they be neglected!
translations.idiomatic: Plans to secure the frontier must not be neglected!
